[SWS_CM_10410] InstanceIdentifier check during the creation of service skeleton
⌈
The Communication Management shall check the value of the In-
stanceIdentifier argument: the identifier shall be unique, using the same instance
identifier for the creation of more than one skeleton instance of the same service shall
cause error handling according to [SWS_CORE_00001].
⌋
